abilities.name: Ember Dart
abilities.effect: A narrow ember shot; preserves Homura's current bolt and armor exposure.

abilities.name: Root Circle
abilities.effect: Radial push and one-heart heal with a separate 360-update heal lock; preserves Midori.

abilities.name: Gust Fan
abilities.effect: Directional projectile clearing and wind-up interruption; preserves Fuuri.

abilities.name: Stone Guard
abilities.effect: A 36-update one-hit guard and short-range interrupt; preserves Kohaku.

abilities.name: Hearthline
abilities.effect: Trace three warm floor cells; after a 24-update warning they flare once. No lingering multi-hit stacking.

abilities.name: Canopy Knot
abilities.effect: Root a target in a small patch for 60 updates and shield the hero from one projectile; does not stack with Stone Guard.

abilities.name: Slipstream Loom
abilities.effect: Place a 48-update curved air lane; bends hostile shots sideways, without reflecting damage or changing collision.

abilities.name: Vaultstep
abilities.effect: Plant an arch-shaped shield for 48 updates; hold one additional hit, but forbid attacking during its 12-update root.

abilities.name: Dew Ring
abilities.effect: Lay a small water ring that slows ordinary enemy movement for 60 updates; bosses are not immobilized.

abilities.name: Tide Stitch
abilities.effect: Connect two marked pools for a single dash-back rescue; never crosses unmarked walls or story gates.

abilities.name: Chime Pin
abilities.effect: Send a returning tuning pin that cancels one telegraphed attack; misses have a long recovery.

abilities.name: Quiet Orbit
abilities.effect: Place three orbiting drops that cancel at most three projectiles over 120 updates; each saved drop becomes one counter-shot on expiry.

forms.name: Homura
forms.silhouette: Compact fox with one curled wick tail and a low forward body line; keep the existing original sprite.
forms.motion: Quick two-step scurry; tail settles a beat later.

forms.name: Homura Hearthkeeper
forms.silhouette: Longer low fox with a broad ceramic hearth mantle and three ash fins, retaining its single tail; never add multiple tails.
forms.motion: Plants the mantle before tracing a deliberate floor line.

forms.name: Midori
forms.silhouette: The existing hovering leaf spirit, with its broad leaf body and visible seed core.
forms.motion: Soft side-to-side float with an asymmetric leaf fold.

forms.name: Midori Canopykeeper
forms.silhouette: An inverted umbrella of three leaves with a suspended seed and visible braided root hem.
forms.motion: Opens the canopy, then anchors roots before a shield appears.

forms.name: Fuuri
forms.silhouette: Keep the cream moth-spirit, lavender feather-like wings and split ribbon tail already in the campaign.
forms.motion: Unequal wingbeats create a visible gust; ribbon follows the turn.

forms.name: Fuuri Windweaver
forms.silhouette: A spindle-bodied silk moth with four narrow sail panels and a woven open loop trailing below.
forms.motion: Tilts the panels in sequence to draw curved air paths.

forms.name: Kohaku
forms.silhouette: Keep the three segmented amber plates, two moss sprouts and tiny feet; it is not a turtle.
forms.motion: Short deliberate steps; the three plates compress during guard.

forms.name: Kohaku Archwarden
forms.silhouette: Four pillar feet carry an open amber arch with a hollow center and moss lintel, not a larger solid shell.
forms.motion: Pillars spread and the arch locks; rocks chime once on impact.
forms.role: Stationary two-hit defense with a mobility cost

forms.name: Dewspindle
forms.silhouette: A translucent spiral droplet suspended from two reed-like legs, with no fish or amphibian outline.
forms.motion: Alternating stilt steps draw tiny circular ripples.

forms.name: Tidewheel
forms.silhouette: A vertical ring of water turns around a hollow reed axle; two spoon-shaped feet skim pools.
forms.motion: Wheel rotates while feet stay level, then unwinds into a linking strand.

forms.name: Chimeclasp
forms.silhouette: A spring-jawed bronze clasp on three unequal prongs, with one suspended tuning tongue.
forms.motion: Coils, releases a tuning pin, then catches it with an audible clasp.

forms.name: Stilltide Orrery
forms.silhouette: Three independent water arcs revolve around a small dark pebble, with a clear central void and no animal head.
forms.motion: Each arc slows separately when absorbing a shot, then realigns into a quiet orbit.
forms.role: Legendary projectile defense and delayed counterplay

trials.description: Reconnect the paired marked pools in the reed-basin side quest.
Complete the fixed three-vane no-projectile-hit wind-loom challenge after Sky clear; retries cost nothing.
Brace the two restoration pillars in one timed trial after Core clear; retries cost nothing.
Restore three distinct damaged root beds; repeated healing never counts.
Light three distinct abandoned hearths once each, then choose to nurture Homura at the sanctuary.
Complete the five-phase relay, then survive 90 active-play seconds using two opposite-polarity support switches; failure resets only the trial.
